verdict.rationale: The evidence shows live data syncing and auto-updating outputs, such as 'the deck builds itself' (abacum-docs-8). That is automatic data refresh, not user-configured automations or scheduled agent tasks running autonomously in the background, so it is adjacent behavior and earns no credit. No documentation describes setting up workflows, triggers, schedules, or autonomous background jobs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
